meta.name: A Little Princess
meta.description: Mal-soon is poor 72-years-old granny and enjoys her single life. One day, Gong-ju and her baby sister appear in front of Mal-soon. Gong-ju introduces herself as Mal-soon's granddaughter. Since then, Mal-soon's peaceful life changes.
meta.slogan: Out Of Nowhere, She Came Into My Life.
